Neo series · N3

Neo Revelation

Released September 21, 2001 · 66 cards

Neo Revelation is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Neo series, released in English on September 21, 2001. Its main set has 64 cards, plus 2 secret rares numbered beyond the set (66 in total). It includes 61 Pokémon, 5 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

20 illustrators worked on Neo Revelation. Most cards: Ken Sugimori (7), Keiji Kinebuchi (5), Sumiyoshi Kizuki (5), Atsuko Nishida (4), Kagemaru Himeno (4), Miki Tanaka (4), Mitsuhiro Arita (4), Tomokazu Komiya (4).
